blind_spots.blind_spot: Self-service e-commerce tasking model ('a few clicks', 'instant delivery') assumes continuous connectivity to place orders and pull imagery.
blind_spots.operator_reality: At an austere OCONUS node with intermittent SATCOM, the live tasking/checkout loop breaks the moment comms go denied or degraded — the platform needs offline queuing and store-and-forward, not a real-time API call, exactly like the 30fps crowd-detection case that needed frame-rate decoupling.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Core product built for a 179-country commercial/civilian customer base where the self-service UX is the differentiator, so DDIL was never a design constraint until SOCOM showed up.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Instant access to satellite imagery and geospatial analytics, right at your fingertips.

blind_spots.blind_spot: No mention anywhere of ATO/RMF, IL4/IL5, or CMMC despite now handling GEOINT tasking for a SOCOM pilot.
blind_spots.operator_reality: A commercial marketplace billing architecture ('Starting at $15', 'Starting at $200') built for consumer/enterprise credit-card checkout will need substantial re-architecture to clear an ATO on a government network before Phase II — the pricing-page UX is not the same system that survives a STIG scan.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Company's entire go-to-market and site language is dual-use commercial-first; the SOCOM contract is a bolt-on pilot, not yet a compliance-driven product line.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Only Pay for What You Need with Lowest-in-Market, Transparent Pricing

blind_spots.blind_spot: The ATAK plugin is described purely as a feature ('Download now') with zero language about who trains the operator, sustains the app, or handles device/battery logistics in the field.
blind_spots.operator_reality: A sergeant who got 20 minutes of training and a plugin that assumes internet-grade tasking will not troubleshoot a failed image order mid-mission; without a named training/sustainment plan the plugin gets abandoned after the first field failure, the classic operator-loves-it-but-nobody-champions-it failure mode.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: SkyFi's messaging optimizes for frictionless commercial self-service ('no lengthy commitments, complex contracts, or demanding account management'), the opposite instinct from building a sustainment/training plan for a deployed military user.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Access satellite imagery with SkyFi's ATAK Plugin, which enables live tasking and analytics, giving field operators real-time situational awareness.

opener_hook: SOCOM's Phase I study is testing SkyFi's ATAK plugin's live-tasking loop — worth knowing how it behaves once comms go denied or intermittent, before Phase II funding decisions.
what_they_do: Self-service commercial marketplace for tasking satellites and buying geospatial imagery/analytics, now piloting an ATAK plugin under a SOCOM Phase I study.
